name: flee_script
instruction: Skeletons should run away from the hero when their health drops below 3.
canon:
[faction/restless-dead] The Restless Dead — Skeletons of the keep's old defenders, risen and hostile to the living.
tags: enemy, undead, skeleton
haunts location/old-keep
They fight as they did in life, in close melee with rusted blades. Nobody knows what woke
them. They don't speak and don't flee; they guard the keep as if the siege never ended.

[style/tone] Tone and style — Cozy-dark folk tale: small stakes, warm people, eerie places; plain spoken dialogue.
tags: tone, style guide
- Dialogue is short and plain-spoken; villagers talk like farmers, not poets.
- Humor is dry and gentle. No modern slang, no pop-culture references.
- The undead are eerie and sad rather than gory.
- Names are short and rural-English sounding (Aren, Tamsin, Brookvale).

[location/old-keep] The Old Keep — A ruined hill fort whose courtyard is now overrun by the restless dead.
tags: ruin, dungeon, courtyard
haunted_by faction/restless-dead
Abandoned for a century after a siege nobody in Brookvale remembers clearly. The walls
still stand; the courtyard is littered with crates, rocks and the bones of the defenders,
some of which no longer lie still.

[character/hero] Aren — A young warden sent alone to clear the old keep, the hero of the game.
tags: player, warden
serves faction/wardens
protects location/brookvale
Aren is barely past training, sworn to the Wardens a year ago. Earnest, a little
reckless, and quick with a sword. Aren grew up in Brookvale and knows most of its people
by name, which is why the Wardens sent Aren when the dead started walking near the keep.

[faction/wardens] The Wardens — A small order that protects the valley's villages from what comes out of the old places.
tags: order, protectors
Under-funded and spread thin across the valley. A Warden carries a sword, a lantern and
the right to ask any village for bread and a bed.

[location/brookvale] Brookvale — A small farming village at the foot of the hill where the old keep stands.
tags: village, home
near location/old-keep
Thatched roofs, a mill on the brook, and a single crossroads shrine. Since the skeletons
appeared, nobody walks the hill road after dark.
responses:
{
  "scope": "task",
  "summary": "Make skeletons flee when their health drops below 3.",
  "plan": [
    "Write a new Lua script for skeletons that checks health and flees when low.",
    "Attach the new script to the skeleton prefab, replacing the old one.",
    "Test in-game: skeletons should now flee when hurt enough."
  ],
  "operations": [
    {
      "op": "command",
      "name": "script.write",
      "args": {
        "path": "scripts/enemy_flee.lua",
        "source": "-- enemy_flee.lua: a melee enemy that flees when hurt.
-- Chasing is handled by the entity's Follow component; this script
-- decides when to swing and when to flee.

properties = {
    swing_range = 1.1,   -- cells; a bit more than MeleeAttack.reach
    flee_threshold = 3,  -- flee when health drops below this
    taunt = "",         -- a sound to play when it first spots the player
    flee_speed = 3.0     -- cells per second when fleeing
}

local spotted = false
local fleeing = false
local normal_speed = nil

function update(dt)
    local target, distance = find_nearest("Player")
    if not target then
        return
    end
    if not spotted and distance < get_field(self_id(), "Follow", "range") then
        spotted = true
        if properties.taunt ~= "" then
            play_sound(properties.taunt)
        end
    end
    -- Check health and decide whether to flee
    local current_health, max_health = get_health()
    if current_health < properties.flee_threshold and not fleeing then
        fleeing = true
        normal_speed = get_field(self_id(), "Follow", "speed")
        set_field(self_id(), "Follow", "speed", properties.flee_speed)
        set_field(self_id(), "Follow", "target", nil)  -- flee from the player
    elseif current_health >= properties.flee_threshold and fleeing then
        fleeing = false
        set_field(self_id(), "Follow", "speed", normal_speed)
    end

    if not fleeing and distance < properties.swing_range then
        attack_toward(target)
    end
end"
      }
    }
  ],
  "done": false,
  "notes": "The new script keeps the skeleton's existing attack behavior but adds fleeing when health drops below 3. The Follow component's speed is temporarily increased to flee, and its target is cleared to make it flee from the player. The original speed is restored if health recovers above the threshold."
}
